threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Overground' instead of just 'the train' like everyone else. It's an instant giveaway, mate.
Caught a glimpse of a bloke serenading the night bus crew with a ukulele on the 35. Only in Brixton, I swear!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When you realize the guy selling Berlinschnitzel on the corner knows your order by heart after just a few visits. That's when you really belong.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Neukölln can you find a bar that doubles as a thrift shop and a craft fair. One night you're sipping cocktails, the next you're browsing vintage clothes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their skill at dodging BART delays. If they know all the coffee spots near the Civic Center that stay open during emergencies, they’re homegrown.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 6 bus stuck at a red light while a marching band passed by. Only in SF do the delays come with a soundtrack.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think La Rambla is the heart of Barcelona, but real life pulses in the small plazas of Gràcia, where the local kids play and families gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newcomer by their bewilderment at the metro ticket machines; locals know it’s cash only after 9 PM.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus stops without a signal, like it’s a set of secret handshakes only locals know.
The 77 bus last night had a guy singing old Skatalites tracks. Whole bus joined in. Never thought I'd see a Brixton karaoke on wheels!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a kebab shop that opens at 3 AM, and the guy behind the counter knows my order by heart. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you enjoy a lecture about philosophy while munching on vegan döner next to a 80s-themed retro arcade. It's oddly perfect.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they know the secret spots to park when Civic Center's a mess, like that spot behind the old church. Saves you 30 minutes, easy.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, I watched a whole Muni bus stop to let a mime finish his routine. Only in SF does public transit pause for street art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but they miss the quiet plazas where locals sip vermut and catch up on life. That's the real charm.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look at the metro map like it’s a puzzle to solve. Locals know it’s just a straight shot most times.
